# Tree Entry

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:TreeEntry`](gmeow-TreeEntry.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/TreeEntry>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/software`](../../slices/software.md)

A named pointer within a source tree — a file or directory entry carrying a name, a file mode, and a reference to a [`Blob`](gmeow-Blob.md) or [`SourceTree`](gmeow-SourceTree.md). Corresponds to a single line in a git tree object. Not content-addressed on its own; it acquires identity only as part of the tree that contains it.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:InformationObject`](gmeow-InformationObject.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:TreeEntry`](gmeow-TreeEntry.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:InformationObject`](gmeow-InformationObject.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
